posts.title: Harsh ban time
posts.html:
The server you were banned from: ||VM|| Roleplay server
Ingame Name: ThaT [KC]
SteamID: STEAM_0:0:15913940
Ban Reason: Prop Push
Ban Length: 48 hours
Admin who banned you: No clue. I joined and my screen turned black and it said i was banned
Why we should unban you: I understood why I was banned. I did the wrong thing and i messed up big time. This ban made half the VM community think i am a bad person but the truth is i am not. The true story was a police chief that had serious issues. I was at a base with my friends when all the sudden i was random warranted. The police chief thought we had drugs but he had no proof of anything. He thought "ohh let me just warrant him in check." I was facing the door to the drugs to lock it when all of the sudden a Deagle blew my head off. I had a UMP on my back that he took and then he blew my drugs up and my friends. Then i decided to base alone in a secret location. The same cop came and did the same thing. I wish i could remember his name but i was not on the server for about 3 days due to a family emergency and i forgot his name . Anyway the same cop came to my base and head shot me through a wall. I lost a UMP and a Glock. Then i decided to take manners into my own hands by prop pushing him. The only reason i did this is because i saw him with my glock shooting me. He his me a few times but i failed at prop pushing so i decided to equip my last Glock. Once i got it out he shot me in the face in about 5 shots. I was extremely disappointed and that is why i broke the rule.

I feel i deserve another chance. If you agree please post a +1. If you dissagree post a -1 with a reason why i should not be unbanned.

Thankyou For reading
-ThaT
